name: red-handed
description: Reads the Claude Code session transcripts under ~/.claude/projects for the current project, lines them up against the repository's git state, and reports where the agent's claims are not supported by its own record: a "tests pass" message with no test run behind it, a claim made right after the last run failed, an expected value rewritten to match a failure, a test switched off, a commit made past a rejecting hook, a suite that quietly got smaller. Every finding quotes the timestamp and the line it came from. Runs a local CLI over local files only. It makes no network calls, sends no telemetry and calls no model, so the same session always produces the same answer.
